stories.title: Mendonça mandou leiloar mansão de R$ 30 milhões de Vorcaro que PF queria usar como local de trabalho

en.title: Mendonça ordered auction of R$ 30 million mansion of Vorcaro that PF wanted to use as work location
en.summary: The Federal Police requested authorization from the Supreme Court to convert a R$ 30 million mansion owned by former banker Daniel Vorcaro into a local base for combating corruption and money laundering in Belo Horizonte.

stories.title: Lula diz sobre Master que 'quem fez putaria vai ser desmascarado'

en.title: Lula says about Master that 'whoever committed wrongdoing will be unmasked'
en.summary: President Lula criticized Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça's role as rapporteur in the Banco Master case during a campaign event in Curitiba.

stories.title: ‘Dark Horse’ gastou mais de R$ 800 mil em segurança, hospedagem e peruca de ator de Bolsonaro

en.title: 'Dark Horse' spent over R$ 800 thousand on security, accommodation and actor's wig for Bolsonaro
en.summary: The film Dark Horse, a biographical movie about former president Bolsonaro, incurred expenses exceeding R$ 800 thousand for security, lodging, and related costs.

stories.title: PF aponta cobranças de Flávio a Vorcaro por filme Dark Horse

en.title: PF points to charges by Flávio to Vorcaro for Dark Horse film
en.summary: Federal Police reports detail messages between senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro regarding financing for the Dark Horse film, and investigate possible involvement by former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro in resource arrangements.

stories.title: Bancários rejeitam proposta da Caixa e mantêm greve nacional

en.title: Bank employees reject Caixa proposal and maintain national strike
en.summary: Employees of Caixa Econômica Federal rejected the bank's final proposal and voted to continue their national strike begun on Thursday. The dispute centers on Saúde Caixa, the employees' health insurance plan, with the bank proposing changes to its model.

stories.title: Líderes do Brics expressam preocupação com o Oriente Médio e condenam sanções unilaterais em cúpula

en.title: Brics leaders express concern over Middle East and condemn unilateral sanctions at summit
en.summary: Leaders of the Brics nations expressed concern regarding the Middle East situation and issued a statement opposing unilateral sanctions during their summit meeting.

stories.title: PF quis usar mansão de R$ 12 milhões de Vorcaro como base de combate à corrupção em MG; veja fotos

en.title: PF wanted to use R$ 12 million mansion of Vorcaro as base to fight corruption in MG; see photos
en.summary: The Federal Police sought to use a 12 million reais mansion belonging to Vorcaro as an operational base for anti-corruption efforts in Minas Gerais.

stories.title: Gilmar reforça a Fachin pedido de acesso integral a celular de Vorcaro

en.title: Gilmar reinforces to Fachin request for full access to Vorcaro's cellphone
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes requested that Court President Edson Fachin ensure all justices participating in Tuesday's trial receive complete access to data extracted from ex-banker Daniel Vorcaro's cellphone.

stories.title: Bancários negam proposta da Caixa e greve nacional continua

en.title: Bank workers reject Caixa proposal and national strike continues
en.summary: Employees of Caixa Econômica Federal rejected the bank's proposal to end the national strike that began on Thursday (10). The strike continues while union entities maintain negotiations focused primarily on the health plan.

stories.title: Gilmar repete Zanin e pede acesso a celular de Vorcaro

en.title: Gilmar repeats Zanin and requests access to Vorcaro's cellphone
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes requested that all court colleagues receive access to former banker Daniel Vorcaro's cellphone data and copies of all investigation documents related to Banco Master.

stories.title: Campanha de Lula usará caso Master contra Flávio Bolsonaro em programa de TV

en.title: Lula's campaign will use Master case against Flávio Bolsonaro in TV program
en.summary: President Lula's reelection campaign will use television to argue that his main opponent, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, lacks capacity to combat crime due to connections with investigated individuals including former Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro, and will also question his ability to fight inflation.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: Dino sequestrou 'Dark Horse' para usá-lo ilegalmente contra mim

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: Dino seized 'Dark Horse' to use it illegally against me
en.summary: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino, accusing him of improperly seizing the investigation related to the Dark Horse case.

stories.title: PF pediu rastreamento de pendrive enviado a Vorcaro na Papudinha

en.title: Federal Police requested tracking of USB drive sent to Vorcaro at Papudinha
en.summary: Brazilian Federal Police requested forensic analysis to identify who handled and which equipment processed a 64GB USB drive intended for former Banco Master controller Daniel Vorcaro in prison. The device was confiscated after inspection found file formats incompatible with its stated purpose of containing only music.

stories.title: Caso Master: Mendonça bloqueou R$ 5,9 milhões em bens de Jaques Wagner

en.title: Master case: Mendonça blocked R$ 5.9 million in assets belonging to Jaques Wagner
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça ordered the blocking of up to R$ 5.95 million in assets from Senator Jaques Wagner in the Banco Master investigation. The amount includes a luxury apartment valued at R$ 2.45 million and a R$ 3.5 million transfer to Wagner's family member, allegedly provided by former banker Daniel Vorcaro.

stories.title: Polícia Federal queria usar mansão de Vorcaro como sede em BH, mas Mendonça vetou

en.title: Federal Police wanted to use Vorcaro's mansion as headquarters in Belo Horizonte, but Mendonça vetoed it
en.summary: Federal Police discovered two luxury properties in Belo Horizonte's upscale Belvedere neighborhood allegedly belonging to Banco Master's Daniel Vorcaro but registered under different names. Justice Mendonça vetoed the police's intention to use one mansion as a headquarters.

stories.title: Janja é vaiada durante comício de Lula em Curitiba

en.title: Janja is booed during Lula rally in Curitiba
en.summary: First Lady Rosângela Lula da Silva was booed by people in nearby buildings during President Lula's campaign rally in Curitiba on Saturday. Lula used the event to discuss new Master case revelations and advocate for increased income.

stories.title: Com pneumonia, Caiado segue internado e deve ter alta no domingo

en.title: With pneumonia, Caiado remains hospitalized and should be discharged on Sunday
en.summary: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD presidential candidate, reported feeling better while hospitalized for pneumonia since Thursday and expects to leave the hospital on Sunday. He plans to return to campaign activities on Monday.
